boundary: Eligibility means the object states an identifier of the kind the source is keyed on (its own name or host, or one another source states for it); attached means a row reached it by that exact identifier. Missing at provider is the provider's silence for those identifiers, not an absence of the object. Nothing here changes identity or object counts.

definitions.declared: Declared: present in the versioned source universe.
definitions.applicable: Applicable: scientifically relevant and queryable for at least one object of this release (an object states an identifier of the kind the source is keyed on).
definitions.executed: Executed: an actual bounded query, snapshot lookup or retrieval attempt occurred for this release. Null for live per-target sources: they run in the visitor's browser and the builder records nothing about them (the monitor's canary checks are in source-monitor.json).
definitions.dataBearing: Data-bearing: valid rows were returned and retained for at least one object.
